title: Impersonate a role
hint: On this device only, your rights narrow to exactly the ticked roles until you switch back, for {hours} hours at most. No role ticked: player view.
tableLabel: Roles to impersonate and what they open
playerHint: No platform role: the site treats you as a player. Your team roles stay yours.

ARBITRE.opens: Tournaments and matches, board preview, live, schedule
ARBITRE.hint: Creates and manages tournaments, enters and settles scores, takes a match as referee, reads the board preview, opens the live and gives availability on the schedule. No reports, no roles, no schedule computing.

CASTER.opens: Board preview, live of own casts, schedule
CASTER.hint: Signs up to cast a match, sets up the cast, opens the live and reads the board preview before launch; gives availability on the schedule. No tournament management.

PROD.hint: Reads the “Schedule” page and gives availability and preferences there; takes or leaves a match's prod spot. No live, no board preview.

COMMUNITY_MANAGER.hint: Manages the showcase partners, the association pages and the volunteers. No rights on tournaments.

RECRUTEUR.hint: Manages the posts of the recruitment page, and nothing else.

DEV.hint: Reads the technical documentation of the site and the bot, read-only. Not staff: no bot commands nor staff sections.
